rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the refactoring of the data classes from `draw_io_parser.py`. The `Individual` and `Arrow` data classes will be moved to `gbad_core/drawio.py` to serve as the structured representation of the parsed graph. The `SerialisationConfig` class will be replaced by the new central configuration object.
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Move `Individual` and `Arrow`:** - Copy the `Individual` and `Arrow` data class definitions to the `gbad_core/drawio.py` module. 2. **Update `DrawIOParser`:** - The `parse()` method of the new `DrawIOParser` class will return a list or generator of `Individual` and `Arrow` objects. 3. **Remove `SerialisationConfig`:** - The `SerialisationConfig` class will be removed. Its functionality will be replaced by the new central configuration object that will be passed to the pipeline.
